scanner.title: Scan book page
scanner.subtitle: Capture or upload a clear book page to recognize Vietnamese text.
scanner.heading: Place page in camera frame
scanner.guide: Place the book upright and well-lit within the 4 corners, or take or choose a page photo to recognize Vietnamese text accurately.
scanner.captureAria: Capture directly with camera to scan page
scanner.step1Body: Adjusting photo orientation and optimizing clarity…
scanner.step2Body: Sending image to the Vietnamese page recognition system…
scanner.jobHeadlineQueuedOffline: Page saved in queue — Recognition will start automatically once ready
scanner.openLibraryForReading: Open library to start reading session
scanner.cameraNotReadyBody: Cannot access live camera or camera permission is disabled. Parents can use the device camera button or choose a page image to scan.
scanner.cameraOffBody: Enable the live scanner or take a clear photo using your phone's native camera—images are automatically rotated and optimized for Vietnamese diacritics.
scanner.afterMatchBody: ViRead will open the book details for you to select the page range. The microphone will be checked during the reading preparation step.
scanner.errorCancelled: Page recognition task cancelled. You may select a different image.
scanner.errorTimeout: Page recognition timed out. Please tap Retry with this image.
scanner.errorWorkerOffline: The page recognition system is temporarily paused. Please wait a moment and tap Retry.
scanner.errorWithDetail: Unable to recognize Vietnamese text in this image ({detail}). Please take a clearer photo or tap Retry.
scanner.errorGeneric: Unable to recognize the page at this time. Please ensure the photo is clear and well-lit, then tap Retry.
scanner.errorTooLargeAfterOptimize: The image exceeds the 12 MB limit after optimization. Please choose a clearer, smaller image.
scanner.errorQueuedTooLong: This page image is still in the recognition queue. Please wait a moment and tap Retry with this image.
scanner.errorSessionExpired: Session expired. Please log in again to continue scanning the book page.
scanner.errorSubmitFailed: Could not send the page image for recognition right now. Please try again.
scanner.errorUnsupportedFormat: Unsupported image format. Please select JPG, PNG, or WebP.
scanner.errorEmptyFile: Image file is empty. Please select another image.
scanner.errorFileTooLarge: Image exceeds 32 MB limit. Please select a smaller file.
scanner.workerOfflineBannerBody: Page recognition is temporarily paused — You can still capture or upload photos to save them in the queue; ViRead will recognize them automatically once ready.
scanner.workerUnreachableBannerTitle: Page recognition is starting up or temporarily busy
scanner.workerUnreachableBannerBody: Could not check recognition status right now due to startup or a slow connection. You can still upload images to the queue or check again in a few seconds.
scanner.queuedListHeading: Other pages saved in the queue ({count} pages)
scanner.jobSubtitleQueuedOffline: Waiting in queue for recognition — your image is safely saved and won't be lost if you leave or reload.
scanner.selectImageOfflineQueue: Capture / Upload image to OCR queue
scanner.queuedListStandaloneHeading: Pages saved in the queue ({count} pages)

camera.missingBookInfo: ViRead recognized the page but missing book info. Please align and scan again.
camera.invalidPageInfo: ViRead did not receive valid page info. Please align and scan again.
camera.connectingMessage: Connecting to ViRead. Keep the book steady.
camera.pausedStatus: Camera paused. Tap to resume scanning.
camera.alignGuideStatus: Place the page vertically within the 4 corners for fastest recognition.
camera.pausedBody: Tap below to restart the camera or select an image.
camera.deniedTitle: Cannot enable camera on this device
camera.deniedBody: Please grant Camera access to ViRead or use the Select book page button below.
camera.holdSteadyOverlay: Valid frame · Hold steady to match page
camera.alignCornersOverlay: Align the 4 edges of the page within the frame

serviceStatus.parentUnavailableBody: Page recognition is temporarily paused — you can still capture or upload photos to save them in the queue; ViRead will recognize them automatically once ready.
serviceStatus.parentUnreachableTitle: Page recognition is starting up or temporarily busy
serviceStatus.parentUnreachableBody: Could not verify recognition service status due to startup or a slow connection. You can still upload images to the queue or recheck in a few seconds.
serviceStatus.adminUnavailableTitle: OCR processing service is currently offline
serviceStatus.adminUnavailableBody: You can still upload images or PDF/DOCX files right now: they will be safely queued and processed automatically once the OCR service is back online.
serviceStatus.adminUnreachableTitle: Unable to verify OCR service status
serviceStatus.adminUnreachableBody: The service is starting up or the connection is slow. You can recheck now or upload files into the queue.
serviceStatus.recoveredMessage: Text recognition (OCR) is back online — queued pages will now be processed automatically.
serviceStatus.taskCenterOfflineIdleBanner: OCR service is currently unavailable — newly uploaded pages will be safely saved in the queue and processed automatically once OCR is back online.
